claim_rule: surface depth-per-dose, development replay, evaluated feature depth, a source fixed-time rate/profile board, and value-blind held-out feature prediction are distinct evidence classes and may not be relabeled as one another

boards.chemistry_and_material: mass-selected SF5+ on Si and SiO2
boards.boundary_strength: mass-selected ion; measured energy and sample-position dose; normal incidence
boards.scope: retrospective no-yield-fit atomistic-provider validation against mass-selected SF5+ beam depth-per-dose; not a feature or reactor prediction

boards.chemistry_and_material: Cl2 adsorption plus Ar+ on Si
boards.boundary_strength: measured positive-ion fluence; inferred mean energy; no measured species-resolved IEAD
boards.scope: no-depth-fit absolute Si/Cl2/Ar+ ALE cross-source validation; not a blind prediction and not a measured species-resolved IEAD

boards.chemistry_and_material: monoenergetic Ar+ plus molecular Cl2 on masked Si
boards.boundary_strength: monoenergetic normal Ar+ and isotropic Cl2 with measured sample-position current, but Figure 11 omits the case-specific current/fluence and exposure time
boards.scope: Excellent boundary-identified Cl2/Si surface and neutral-transport board; the 1997 article alone does not identify absolute feature depth because Figure 11 omits exposure time and case-specific ion fluence. Do not fit time to the reported depth.

boards.chemistry_and_material: CF4/C4F6/He ICP on ACL-masked SiO2 lines
boards.boundary_strength: same-reactor Te, aggregate ion current, self-bias, relative OES, XPS, and patterned rates; no species-resolved ion flux, IEAD, or absolute neutrals
boards.scope: Strong same-reactor C4F6 multi-observable board and an original-pixel absolute patterned-rate dataset. It is not a blind depth validation: the SEM times were selected to equalize depth, the kinetic boundary remains aggregate, and two printed condition/arithmetic inconsistencies must be resolved before a reactor model can receive a formal pass.

boards.boundary_strength: fixed 75 s exposure and absolute rates for every usable run; reactor knobs and corresponding SEM panels are published, but species-resolved wafer flux, measured IEAD, and measured IAD are not
boards.scope: absolute fixed-time chlorine rate/profile targets are ready to grade an independently identified reactor boundary; the scored rates may not be used to select that boundary and then be counted as predictions
published aggregate boundary; base feature was the source mechanism's optimization target; absolute depth misses and remains underidentified

boards.chemistry_and_material: alternating C4F8/SF6 with Ar bias on Si
boards.boundary_strength: same-reactor blanket rates, phase-resolved bulk electron density and OES; no species-resolved wafer flux or IEAD
boards.required_model_state: phase-resolved reactor boundary plus persistent C/F/S-containing surface memory
boards.scope: 49 held-out feature depths are ready but none has been predicted or graded

summary.current_strongest_defensible_statement: absolute surface depth-per-dose transfers without a target fit exist in two non-Krueger chemistry families and an 11-point fixed-time chlorine rate/profile board is ready; no chemistry yet has a completed value-blind held-out feature-depth pass
